title: PostHog Personal API key (phx_): one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one body byte replaced by -, outside every era's alphabet and alphabet: one body byte replaced by _, outside every era's alphabet. Twin of "PostHog Personal API key (phx_): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of posthog-token-json-api-key: alphabet: one body byte replaced by -, outside every era's alphabet. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
